strengths: Vanilla HTML/JS with no build step or dependencies
Fetch is strictly relative fetch('/api/scan') with no hardcoded host/port
Refresh loading state disables button and shows 'Memindai…' then restores
requestId ordering implemented and verified by rapid-refresh race test
Two tabs with static Indonesian guide containing whitelist, manual Explorer steps, don't-touch list, and >14 day tip
Distinct empty-state copies for access_denied vs not_found
Partial response marks grand total as lower bound with '≥' prefix
No child_process/spawn/exec, no Open in Explorer, no per-file listing or age computation

issues.description: clearElement sets element.children.length = 0 — non-standard for live HTMLCollection; innerHTML='' already clears real DOM, assignment only satisfies test mock. Harmless but redundant.
Loading state clears when latest-sent request completes even if earlier requests still in-flight — re-enables Refresh early during overlapping scans. Single-request behavior matches spec/tests.
